summary: Miscommunication caused approximately 60-foot fall on Iron Horse, Eldorado Canyon; major fractures; RMRG and helicopter.
notes: MERGED 2026-09-11 (run 102): MRA Meridian Summer 2015 'Cliff Notes' case report by RMRG physician Alison Sheets (first on scene; paged just before 5 p.m.) — mid-wall litter loading with 1:1 raise from above, full-body vacuum splint, short vertical section + long scree descent, hand carry over the river to the ambulance, short drive to helicopter LZ, flight to a Denver level-1 trauma center; injuries: large scalp laceration, facial fractures, central cord contusion with ligamentous injury at C4-C5, L1 compression fracture, pelvic fracture, tibia/fibula fracture, calcaneus fracture; 1 wk ICU + 2 wk trauma + 3 wk Craig Hospital rehab; persistent neurologic deficit at 7 months.
